title: Page 9
content_zh:
“呵……大哥的自制力还真好，这样都忍得住。”佟映晨轻笑，才不相信杜天云会看不出来妻子的用意，只是她也很纳闷他迟迟不和关颖佳发生亲密关系，但又不能代替关颖佳去问他。
“你别笑，快帮我想办法啦！”她现在只想摧毁丈夫的自制力，让杜天云为她疯狂，可是却苦思不得计策，所以只好再来找佟映晨商量。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
“其实，我是有想到一个办法。”佟映晨想了想，是有一计也许能动摇杜天云过人的自制力，瓦解他的理智。
“是什么？”他迫不及待地想知道。
“听过‘酒后乱性’吧？”任何人喝下酒都会“乱”，只是方向和程度上的不同。
“你是要我灌醉他？”这听起来就很刺激耶，而且有点主动又不会太主动……
真是一个失身的好办法！
“嗯，不过也不能让他醉过头，而且你最好先想清楚，这真是你想要的结果吗？”她慎重的提醒关佳颖，会成功的方法不一定会带来最好的结果。
“为什么不是？”她都听糊涂了。
“因为通常两个人的身体愈紧密，心里的感觉就愈深刻……如果有天他伤了你的心，你也会感到加倍的痛苦和难过。”肉体的关心往往会牵动心灵的依赖，而当感情陷得愈深刻却得不到对方的回应时，这些亲密与付出都会成为讲开反击自己的力道，让自己的心摔的更重，更伤，所以她希望关佳颖三思而后行。
“没关系，因为如果我觉得难过，还可以加倍的骂他出气呀。”关佳颖想起了之前跟丈夫说过的话，笑的无忧无虑，一点都不担心。
对于感情，关佳颖没有太对复杂的思考，只知道自己深爱着他，也相信他总有一天会爱上自己，所以她正朝着那一天大步迈进，走向他的心。
“又笑什么？”她看佟映晨突然望着自己笑了出来，她说错什么了吗？
“我觉得你真的很爱大哥。”佟映晨轻摇着头，只是很佩服她有这样勇敢追爱的冲动，即使跌了跤也不怕痛。
“当然喽，不然我为什么要跟他结婚。”她言笑嘻哈，就是一位爱他猜想嫁给他为妻的嘛。
“说的也是。”佟映晨附和着她轻快的语气，然而心里却无法像她一样畅快——是啊，因为有爱才结合的婚姻，自然就有坚守的动力，不像她和杜天海的婚姻，一开始就不存在着爱情……
是她太贪心了。
事不宜迟！既然决定要酒后乱性，关佳颖立刻就展开筹备计划。
刚好半个月后就是关家成与谢淑云的结婚纪念日。本来一向是只有他们一家三口聚在一起庆祝的家庭聚会，但今年为关佳颖的别有用心，特别扩大举办成邀请亲朋好友和数十位自家员工的大型派对——“明明是庆祝我们两的结婚纪念日，为什么大家一直去找佳颖敬酒？”

派对还没进行到一半，关家成发现有些不太对劲。怎么有些人都还没过来跟他说话，就先跑去和女儿敬酒。
“对呀，真奇怪。不过咱们年纪不小了，少喝点酒也好。”谢淑云安抚着丈夫，没告诉他私底下有听过女儿曾在亲自发送邀请函的时候，顺便要求极为有交情的员工今晚务必找她敬酒。
大小姐的话，谁敢不从？但谢淑云也没直接去向女儿求证追问原因，相信女儿会这么做自有其用意。
“你这么早就要走了？”关家成以为女儿会全程参与到结束呢！
“我又不是主角，早点走也没关系嘛。而且天云已经有点醉了，我想先陪他回去休息。”她拉着父亲的手撒娇地说。要是让丈夫醉的不醒人事，她的计划就全毁了！
“你怎么一开始就喝这么多酒？”关家成记得女婿的酒量应该不差，怎么一转眼就喝醉了？
“有什么办法，谁叫我遗传到我爸的好人缘，一直有人来找我敬酒那我老公又疼我，就全帮我挡下咯。”她很无奈地说，这可把父亲给逗乐了。
尽管正常人都应该知道“人缘”这种东西根本没得遗传！
“那你快带女婿回去，好好照顾他。”谢淑云配合地帮腔，觉得女儿遗传到的应该是自己的演戏细胞吧。
瞧她们母女两一搭一唱的，不用预演也能配合得天衣无缝，“好，那我们先走了，谢谢妈，爸再见。”她特别亲了母亲一下，在抱抱父亲，然后连忙回头去找丈夫。
他笑容满面地打发可围在丈夫身边的一群“临时演员”，勾住他的手——“天云，你有点醉客，我们先回家好不好？”看着丈夫的脸有些发红，她的心跳也跟着加速，觉得计划已经胜利在望了。
“我还行，待会儿别再喝酒就好了。”他闭了闭眼，是觉得自己喝多了，不过今天是爸妈的结婚纪念日，他们这么早走似乎有些失礼。
你行，我不行！
“不行，你在留下来，一定还会有人来找我们敬酒，到时候不喝又不好意思，所以我们还是先走吧，而且我的头好像也有点晕了……”她摸着额头心想自己大费周章地把他灌醉，可不能留时间给他站在这里醒酒呀！
“这样啊，那我先去和爸妈打声招呼在回去。”看妻子不太舒服的样子，他也不再坚持了。
“不必了，该说的我都说过了，爸妈也叫我们回去休息，走吧。”她拉着丈夫就往宴会厅的出口走，一点时间都不想耽搁……
今晚，她非要把他弄到手不可！
回程中，酒精的作用愈来愈明显，使杜天云在车上几乎一路闭着眼，开始感觉思绪混沌，下车后的步伐也不太稳……
关佳颖将动作有些迟钝的丈夫扶回卧房，让他坐在床沿，先摘下他的眼镜，在动手替他解开领带，和一颗颗的纽扣……
杜天云有些迷蒙地望着她的动作，看着她的指尖像在跳舞似的在自己胸前移动，不经意地触碰着他，帮他脱衣服，那平凡无奇的动作不知道为什么让他的心头直发热。

“我自己来。”他摸着自己身上尚未解开的纽扣，就接手她的动作。
“老公喝醉了，就让老婆帮你服务一下嘛。”她笑吟吟地拉开他的手，不许他打断她帮丈夫脱衣服的乐趣。
平时他清醒的时候，她只能帮他挑衣服，递衣服，都没什么机会帮他做这种服务呢！
他笑了笑，意识有点涣散，也不顽强地抵抗，直到她的手来到他的腰上，开始解他的皮带——“这我自己来。”他握住她的手，阻止她往下脱。
“好。”这回她柔顺的配合，其实也不太好意思出手脱掉男人的裤子。
不过看他脸更红，疑似有些害羞的神情，她就觉得他实在太可爱了——没想到他一喝醉酒就失了平常的沉稳持重，居然变成一个纯情少年呢！
趁着他脱裤子的同时，她走进浴室里拧了毛巾来帮他擦脸和身体。
他静坐着，感觉到她的手在他脸上动作，双手从他的脸移到他的颈间、胸口……在他厚实的胸膛上来回擦拭……
明明是冰凉的湿毛巾，却在他身上留下烫人的热度，使他的身体愈来愈燥热……
那温柔的动作，像在按摩，也像似爱抚——他低头，发现她温暖的手掌正贴在他的胸前，轻抚着他发烫的皮肤，再往下滑过他结实的腹部！使他浑身紧绷，喉头干渴！
“好了！我还是去洗个澡。”他再次握住她的手，防止她做出更危险的举动。

"Ha... Brother's self-control is really good, he can bear this." Tong Yingchen chuckled, not believing that Du Tianyun could not see his wife's intentions, but she was also puzzled by his delay in having an intimate relationship with Guan Yingjia, but she could not ask him on Guan Yingjia's behalf.
"Don't laugh, help me find a way!" Now she just wanted to destroy her husband's self-control and make Du Tianyun crazy about her, but she couldn't think of a plan, so she had to come to Tong Yingchen to discuss it again.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
"Actually, I have thought of a way." Tong Yingchen thought for a while, and there was a plan that might shake Du Tianyun's extraordinary self-control and undermine his sanity.
"What is it?" he wanted to know eagerly.
"Have you ever heard of 'having sex while drunk'?" Anyone who drinks alcohol can become "promiscuous", but the direction and degree are different.
"You want me to get him drunk?" This sounds exciting, and it's a bit proactive but not too proactive...
What a great way to lose your virginity!
"Well, but you can't let him get too drunk, and you'd better think clearly first, is this really the result you want?" She carefully reminded Guan Jiaying that the successful method may not necessarily bring the best results.
"Why not?" She was confused.
"Because usually the closer two people are physically, the deeper the feeling in their hearts... If one day he breaks your heart, you will feel double the pain and sadness." Physical care often affects the dependence of the soul, and when the relationship becomes deeper but does not receive a response from the other party, these intimacy and dedication will become the strength to fight back against oneself, making one's heart fall harder and more hurt, so she hopes that Guan Jiaying will think twice before acting.
"It doesn't matter, because if I feel sad, I can scold him twice as much to vent my anger." Guan Jiaying remembered what she had said to her husband before, smiling carefree and not worried at all.
Regarding feelings, Guan Jiaying didn't have too complicated thoughts. She only knew that she loved him deeply and believed that he would fall in love with her one day, so she was making strides towards that day and walking towards his heart.
"Why are you laughing again?" She saw Tong Yingchen suddenly looking at her and laughing. Did she say something wrong?
"I think you really love big brother." Tong Yingchen shook her head slightly, but admired her for having such a courageous impulse to pursue love, and she was not afraid of pain even if she fell.
"Of course, otherwise why would I marry him." She was laughing and joking. She was someone who loved him and wanted to marry him.
"That's true." Tong Yingchen echoed her brisk tone, but his heart couldn't be as happy as hers - yes, a marriage that was only united because of love would naturally have the motivation to persevere, unlike her marriage to Du Tianhai, where there was no love at the beginning...
She is too greedy.
Without further ado! Since she decided to have sex after drinking, Guan Jiaying immediately started making preparations.
Exactly half a month later will be the wedding anniversary of Guan Jiacheng and Xie Shuyun. It was always a family gathering where only the three of them got together to celebrate, but this year for Guan Jiaying's ulterior motives, it was specially expanded into a large party inviting relatives, friends and dozens of employees - "It's obviously celebrating our wedding anniversary, why do everyone keep going to Jiaying to toast?"
The party was not even halfway through when Guan Jiacheng realized something was not right. Why did some people run to toast their daughter before they even came over to talk to him?
"Yes, it's really strange. But we're not young anymore, so it's better to drink less." Xie Shuyun comforted her husband, but did not tell him that she had heard in private that her daughter had personally sent invitations and asked employees with whom she was very friendly to have a toast with her tonight.
Who dares to disobey the eldest lady? However, Xie Shuyun did not directly ask her daughter for confirmation and the reason. She believed that her daughter had her own motives for doing this.
"Are you leaving so early?"Guan Jiacheng thought that his daughter would participate in the whole process until the end!
"I'm not the protagonist, so it doesn't matter if I leave early. Besides, Tianyun is already a little drunk. I want to accompany him back to rest first." She held her father's hand and said coquettishly. If she makes her husband drunk and unconscious, all her plans will be ruined!
"Why did you drink so much in the first place?" Guan Jiacheng remembered that his son-in-law should have a good drinking capacity, but why did he get drunk in the blink of an eye?
"Is there any way I can inherit my father's good popularity? People come to me all the time to toast, and my husband loves me, so he helps me block them all." She said helplessly, which made her father amused.
Although normal people should know that "popularity" is not hereditary at all!
"Then take your son-in-law back quickly and take good care of him." Xie Shuyun cooperated, thinking that her daughter should have inherited her acting skills.
Look at their mother and daughter singing together, they can coordinate perfectly without rehearsing, "Okay, let's go first, thank you mom, goodbye dad." She kissed her mother specially, hugged her father, and then quickly turned back to find her husband.
With a smile on his face, he dismissed the group of "extras" surrounding his husband and hooked his hand - "Tianyun, you are a bit drunk, can we go home first?" Seeing her husband's face turning red, her heartbeat also accelerated, feeling that the plan was already in sight.
"I'm okay, just stop drinking later." He closed his eyes, feeling that he had drunk too much, but today was his parents' wedding anniversary, and it seemed rude for them to leave so early.
You can do it, but I can’t!
"No, if you stay, someone will come to us for a toast. It will be embarrassing if you don't drink then, so let's go first. Besides, my head seems to be a little dizzy..." She touched her forehead and thought that she had gone to a lot of trouble to get him drunk, but she couldn't leave him time to stand here and sober up!
"That's it. Then I'll go say hello to my parents and then go back." Seeing that his wife was not feeling well, he stopped insisting.
"No need, I've said everything that needs to be said. Our parents also told us to go back and rest. Let's go." She took her husband and walked towards the exit of the banquet hall, not wanting to waste any time...
Tonight, she had to get him!
On the way back, the effect of alcohol became more and more obvious, causing Du Tianyun to close his eyes almost all the way in the car. His thoughts began to feel chaotic, and his steps after getting off the car were unsteady...
Guan Jiaying helped her husband, who was a little slow, back to the bedroom and asked him to sit on the edge of the bed. She took off his glasses first, and then started to untie his tie and buttons one by one...
Du Tianyun looked at her movements in confusion, watching her fingertips move on his chest as if dancing, touching him inadvertently and helping him take off his clothes. That ordinary movement made his heart feel hot for some reason.
"I'll do it myself." He touched the unbuttoned buttons on his body and took over her actions.
"My husband is drunk, so let my wife help you." She smiled and pulled away his hand, not allowing him to interrupt her fun of helping her husband take off his clothes.
Normally when he was awake, she could only help him pick out clothes and hand them over to him, but she didn't have much chance to do this kind of service for him!
He smiled, his consciousness was a little blurred, and he did not resist tenaciously until her hands came to his waist and began to untie his belt - "I will do this myself." He held her hand and stopped her from taking it off.
"Okay." This time she cooperated docilely, but she was actually too embarrassed to take off the man's pants.
But when she saw that his face was redder and he looked a little shy, she thought he was too cute - she didn't expect that when he got drunk, he lost his usual composure and turned into an innocent boy!
While he was taking off his pants, she walked into the bathroom and twisted a towel to wipe his face and body.
He sat quietly, feeling her hand onHe moved his face, his hands moved from his face to his neck, chest... and wiped back and forth on his thick chest...
It was obviously a cold wet towel, but it left a scalding heat on his body, making his body feel hotter and hotter...
That gentle movement was like massaging or caressing - he lowered his head and found that her warm palms were pressing against his chest, caressing his hot skin, and then sliding down his strong abdomen! It made his whole body tense and his throat thirsty!
"Okay! I'd better take a shower." He held her hand again to prevent her from making more dangerous moves.
